bagPolicy.summary: Michigan Stadium does not allow bags of any kind at football games, including clear bags, purses and fanny packs. Guests with medical or childcare needs can bring one bag sized for those items through a bag exception gate. This is the game-day policy, and concert rules may differ.
allowed: One medical bag, sized for the items needed, after inspection at Gate 3 or Gate 9
One childcare bag, sized for the items needed, after inspection at Gate 3 or Gate 9
prohibited: All bags, including purses, clear bags and fanny packs
Bottles and containers of any kind
bagPolicy.note: Medical and childcare bags must enter through Gate 3 (south end) or Gate 9 West (north end). Bag Check is inside the southeast entrance of Crisler Center off Stadium Way and won't take cash, alcohol, drugs, food, cameras, video cameras or weapons. Email guestservices@umich.edu with questions about permitted items.

parking.note: Football parking lots open between 6 a.m. and noon on game day, and vehicles must leave within two hours after the game or be towed. Many lots are permit only. The Blue Lot is for season ticket holders by priority points, the Brown Lot (Varsity Tennis Center) sells permits on site, and the Maize Lot sells cashless permits on site. Printed digital parking QR codes aren't accepted. Accessible parking is in the Green Lot, first come, first served, with a valid disability placard.
parking.summary: Lots open 6 a.m. to noon on game day and many require a permit.

rideshare.note: Michigan Athletics doesn't post a rideshare zone. TheRide's FootballRide shuttle runs about every 20 minutes starting two hours before kickoff and drops off at Gate 2, and it takes mobile tickets or exact cash. Guests who need to be dropped off and picked up for accessibility reasons can use Gate 2 (Varsity Plaza).
rideshare.summary: No official rideshare zone is posted; the FootballRide shuttle drops off at Gate 2.

concessions.note: Michigan Stadium concessions are cashless, so bring a credit card, debit card or mobile payment. Alcohol is sold at select spots on the outer concourse from one hour before kickoff until the start of the fourth quarter, and not in the student section.
concessions.summary: Concessions are cashless, with alcohol sold from one hour before kickoff to the fourth quarter.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Gates 2 (Varsity Plaza), 4 (Champions Plaza) and 8 (Wolverine Plaza) are ADA accessible entrances, and Gate 2 is the drop-off and pickup point for guests who need it. Accessible parking requires a state-issued disability placard or plate. The stadium has 14 elevators for guests with accessibility needs, free assisted listening devices on loan, wheelchair check-out and a limited number of accessible shuttles. Service dogs and miniature horses are allowed. Email guestservices@umich.edu or call the Michigan Ticket Office at 734-764-0247.
accessibility.summary: Gates 2, 4 and 8 are accessible entrances, and Gate 2 is the accessible drop-off point.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is generally not allowed except in approved emergencies. Premium tower guests who step out to the public concourse need a transit hand stamp to get back into the tower.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Ticket Office locations open two and a half hours before kickoff. General public windows are at the northeast entrance of Crisler Center and the Gate 9 Guest Services west window, and both close at the start of the third quarter. East side club and suite guests use the Jack Roth Stadium Club Entrance, and west side suite guests use the Ross Tower Lobby south of Gate 8.
ticketPickup.summary: Ticket windows open two and a half hours before kickoff at Crisler Center and Gate 9.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: General public Gates 1, 2, 4, 7, 8 and 10 open two hours before kickoff. Gates 3 and 9 are the bag exception gates for medical and childcare bags; Gate 3 closes at the end of the first quarter. Students enter through Gates 8 and 10. Premium entrances open two and a half hours before kickoff.
gates.summary: Public gates open two hours before kickoff, and Gates 3 and 9 handle medical and childcare bags.
